parameters.jsCode: const p=$json.body??$json; for(const k of ['certificate_code','owner_name','vine_name']) if(!String(p[k]??'').trim()) throw new Error('VALIDATION_ERROR:'+k); return [{json:{certificate_code:String(p.certificate_code).trim(),owner_name:String(p.owner_name).trim(),vine_name:String(p.vine_name).trim()}}];

parameters.query: WITH order_row AS (SELECT certificate_code,payment_status,activation_status FROM vine_certificate_service.orders WHERE certificate_code='{{$json.certificate_code}}'), candidate AS (SELECT certificate_code FROM order_row WHERE payment_status='paid' AND activation_status='inactive'), created AS (INSERT INTO vine_certificate_service.vines (certificate_code,owner_name,vine_name,status) SELECT certificate_code,'{{$json.owner_name}}','{{$json.vine_name}}','active' FROM candidate ON CONFLICT (certificate_code) DO NOTHING RETURNING certificate_code), changed AS (UPDATE vine_certificate_service.orders SET activation_status='active',activated_at=now(),updated_at=now() WHERE certificate_code IN (SELECT certificate_code FROM created) RETURNING certificate_code), history AS (INSERT INTO vine_certificate_service.vine_updates (certificate_code,update_text) SELECT certificate_code,'Лоза успешно зарегистрирована и передана под наблюдение.' FROM created) SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_row) THEN 'certificate_not_found' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_row WHERE payment_status <> 'paid') THEN 'activation_denied' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM created) THEN 'active' ELSE 'already_activated' END AS status, '{{$json.certificate_code}}' AS certificate_code;
